subject: Fix minor memory leak in clusterLoadConfig (#741)
reason: The change only adds sdsfreesplitres(argv, argc) before a goto fmterr in clusterLoadConfig; the fmterr path immediately logs and calls exit(1), so the freed memory would have been reclaimed by process termination anyway. There is no observable behavior change on any input — same log, same exit code, same cluster state — making this a code-hygiene/leak-sanitizer fix with nothing a scenario could distinguish.
